camtrapReport: Automated reports for camera-trap data

Source: R/camtrapReport-package.R
camtrapReport-package.Rd

Tools for reading Camtrap DP datasets, summarising camera-trap data, checking data status, and generating automated HTML reports for camera-trap monitoring projects.

Details

The package provides functions to create a camReport object from camera-trap data, inspect and update report metadata, manage modular report sections, and generate ecological and data-status reports.

Main user-facing functions include camData(), report(), status(), info(), reportSection(), updateReportSection(), and gui().
